using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpResults;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using eShop.Ordering.API.Apis;

namespace eShop.Ordering.API.Tests.Apis;

public class OrdersApiTests
{
    private readonly Mock<OrderServices> _mockServices;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<OrdersApi>> _mockLogger;

    public OrdersApiTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<OrdersApi>>();
        _mockServices = new Mock<OrderServices>();
        _mockServices.Setup(s => s.Logger).Returns(_mockLogger.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateOrderAsync_WithEmptyRequestId_LogsWarningAndReturnsBadRequest()
    {
        // Arrange
        var emptyRequestId = Guid.Empty;
        var request = new CreateOrderRequest(
            "user123",
            "John Doe",
            "New York",
            "123 Main St",
            "NY",
            "USA",
            "10001",
            "4111111111111111",
            "John Doe",
            DateTime.Now.AddYears(3),
            "123",
            1,
            "buyer",
            new List<BasketItem>());

        // Act
        var result = await OrdersApi.CreateOrderAsync(emptyRequestId, request, _mockServices.Object);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            logger => logger.LogWarning(
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                "Invalid IntegrationEvent - RequestId is missing - {@IntegrationEvent}",
                It.IsAny<object[]>()),
            Times.Once);

        var badRequestResult = Assert.IsType<Results<Ok, BadRequest<string>>>(result);
        var badRequest = Assert.IsType<BadRequest<string>>(badRequestResult.Value);
        Assert.Equal("RequestId is missing.", badRequest.Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CreateOrderAsync_WithValidRequestId_DoesNotLogWarning()
    {
        // Arrange
        var validRequestId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var request = new CreateOrderRequest(
            "user123",
            "John Doe",
            "New York",
            "123 Main St",
            "NY",
            "USA",
            "10001",
            "4111111111111111",
            "John Doe",
            DateTime.Now.AddYears(3),
            "123",
            1,
            "buyer",
            new List<BasketItem>());

        _mockServices.Setup(s => s.Mediator.Send(It.IsAny<IdentifiedCommand<CreateOrderCommand, bool>>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(true);

        // Act
        var result = await OrdersApi.CreateOrderAsync(validRequestId, request, _mockServices.Object);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            logger => logger.LogWarning(
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<object[]>()),
            Times.Never);

        var okResult = Assert.IsType<Results<Ok, BadRequest<string>>>(result);
        Assert.IsType<Ok>(okResult.Value);
    }
}

    public ILogger<OrdersApi> Logger { get; set; } = null!;
    public object Mediator { get; set; } = null!;

public class CreateOrderCommand
{
    public CreateOrderCommand(object items, string userId, string userName, string city, string street,
        string state, string country, string zipCode, string cardNumber, string cardHolderName,
        DateTime cardExpiration, string cardSecurityNumber, int cardTypeId) { }
}

public class IdentifiedCommand<TCommand, TResult>
{
    public IdentifiedCommand(TCommand command, Guid id) { }
    public Guid Id => Guid.NewGuid();
    public TCommand Command => default!;
    public string GetGenericTypeName() => "TestType";
}
